title: Romantic Homicide
lyrics:
[00:15.80]I'm scared (Oh-oh-oh)
[00:21.52]It feels like you don't care (Oh-oh)
[00:28.77]Enlighten me, my dear (Oh-oh-oh)
[00:36.30]Why am I still here? Mm (Oh-oh)
[00:43.24]I don't mean to be
[00:45.37]Complacent with the decisions you made
[00:51.80]But why? Mm
[00:58.55]In the back of my mind
[01:02.17]You died
[01:05.19]And I didn't even cry
[01:08.58]No, not a single tear
[01:12.43]And I'm sick of waiting patiently
[01:17.35]For someone that won't even arrive
[01:28.99]Oh-oh-oh-oh-oh-oh
[01:42.18]In the back of my mind
[01:45.78]I killed you
[01:48.81]And I didn't even regret it
[01:52.83]I can't believe I said it
[01:56.50]But it's true
[02:03.98]I hate you
